About Our Laundry by KG Service

Cleanzit's laundry-by-weight service is built for everyday clothes — shirts, T-shirts, jeans, kurtas, nightwear, towels and bed linen. We pick up from your door anywhere in Bhopal, wash, dry and either fold or steam iron, and deliver back within 3 days.

You pay by weight, not per piece: Wash & Fold is ₹60/kg, Wash & Steam Iron is ₹90/kg and Premium Wash & Steam Iron is ₹130/kg. A kilogram is roughly five everyday garments.

What's included

  • Doorstep pickup and delivery (free on orders above ₹300)
  • Individual tagging so every garment comes back to you
  • Stain inspection and spot pre-treatment
  • Anti-bacterial wash and drying
  • Folding, or steam ironing on the Wash & Steam Iron plans
  • Optional add-ons: starch (kalaf) and roll press

Getting the most from laundry by kg

  • Keep dry-clean-only pieces (silk, heavy embroidery, suits) out of the laundry bag — send those for dry cleaning instead.
  • Empty pockets: pens and tissues can mark a whole load.
  • Tell us about any stain when you hand over the bag so it can be pre-treated before washing.
  • Pick Wash & Fold for home clothes and towels, and Wash & Steam Iron for office and school wear.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does laundry cost per kg in Bhopal?

At Cleanzit, Wash & Fold is ₹60 per kg, Wash & Steam Iron is ₹90 per kg and Premium Wash & Steam Iron is ₹130 per kg. New customers get 20% off the first order.

How many clothes are in 1 kg of laundry?

Roughly five everyday garments — for example a mix of shirts, T-shirts and trousers. Heavier items such as jeans and towels weigh more.

Is pickup free?

Pickup and delivery are free on orders above ₹300 anywhere in Bhopal.

How long does laundry take?

Standard delivery is within 3 days. Express same-day service is available for an extra charge — ask when you book.
